# Through the Ring PRO

> Through the Ring PRO: Arcade (Offline Tap Ball Game · No Ads) is a one-tap arcade game for iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo (iOS 17 or later). Tap to jump, fly through each ring to open the wall. Paid once, no ads, no tracking, no account needed, works offline. Available in 9 languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Italian and Traditional Chinese.

- [Home](https://chiragmirani.github.io/through-the-ring/): what the game is
- [Support](https://chiragmirani.github.io/through-the-ring/support.html): get the game back, report a bug, common questions
- [Privacy](https://chiragmirani.github.io/through-the-ring/privacy.html): the game collects nothing; Game Center is optional; last updated October 13, 2026
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1203310957)

Version 2.1.1 is live on the App Store (October 13, 2026). The separate Daily Ring mode was merged into Play: every Play run counts on two Game Center leaderboards, today's (resets once a day) and all time. After each run the player sees their place (for example "You're #4 of 11 today"). Players can send the Game Center challenge "Beat My Best Run" to friends (iOS 26 or later). Game Center is optional. Version 2.1 added portrait play on either iPhone Duo display.
